audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer field tracks a fabricated ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Content layer calls QE a 'bolt' (Severing Bolt is QW), writes 'EE (Crushing Maelstrom)' (real: Crushing Maw), 'R Spiral of Torment' (real: Spiraling Despair), and calls QW Severing Bolt his QE escape (his speed-up is WQ Fleeting Current).
audit.why: Riot kit: E is Subject: Torment (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD) holding all his CC; Q subspells are Devastating Fire / Severing Bolt / Molten Fissure; E subspells Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw; R is Spiraling Despair (120/100/80s). W Subject: Serenity (18s) carries the shield that absorbs TF's burst — missing interaction now stated.
audit.corrected: All names replaced with real ones plus cooldown numbers; W shield force-out added to cooldowns advice.

audit.why: E 12s rank 1, W 18s, R 120s are in the kit.

edits.before: Concede the lane politely and invoice the map — Destiny converts shoves into cross-lane kills. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Concede the lane politely and invoice the map — Destiny converts shoves into cross-lane kills. Track Subject: Torment (E, 12s at rank 1) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment's fear or root, chaining Q burst behind it, and out-ranging your plan one poke at a time.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Gold card is the law — locked before his engage range, always. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twisted Fate vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Gold card is the law — locked before his poke range, always. - Engage only in Subject: Torment's 12s downtime. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E): 12s at rank 1 — all his CC lives on this palette; dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Step up in its downtime. - His W shield palette is 18s — force it before you commit. - Your gold card is the lifeline; his 120s R answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Q clears from range while he burns 80-plus mana per poke rotation — farm safe, bank Loaded Dice gold, and reach 6 with the deck intact.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hold yellow for the moment he steps up to paint — the stun stops his second spell, so his passive signature never completes.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — 12 seconds of no CC is your window.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Hwei out-poke-farms you in a static lane — every minute spent trading Qs mid is a minute your Destiny and Gate earned nothing.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q and stay relevant through Destiny map plays.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment's CC range and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q and stay relevant through Destiny map plays.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your Lich Bane spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit in Subject: Torment's 12s downtime, on your Lich Bane spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: Hwei owns level 1: his poke (QQ Devastating Fire and the QE bolt) outranges your auto-and-Wild-Cards trade and there is no all-in threat to keep him honest. Take Blue Card first for the mana to farm under pressure and only throw Q at the wave, never point-blank into his combo. By level 2-3 your own Wild Cards and a picked card let you trade back when he over-commits a cast, since his animations are long and readable. Respect that he wins the pure poke war and just farm to your spike.
edits.after: Hwei owns level 1: his poke (QQ Devastating Fire, QW Severing Bolt) outranges your auto-and-Wild-Cards trade and there is no all-in threat to keep him honest. Take Blue Card first for the mana to farm under pressure and only throw Q at the wave, never point-blank into his combo. By level 2-3 your own Wild Cards and a picked card let you trade back when he over-commits a cast, since his animations are long and readable. Respect that he wins the pure poke war and just farm to your spike.
